action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal White moves to identify candidate best moves and any tactical refutations.
action.rationale: Feedback requires a broad_search phase first: candidate_moves must be empty to cover all legal roots. No prior analyses exist and strongest_exact_evidence is empty, so full root coverage at depth 3-4 within the 3000-node broad allowance is needed before selecting a verification candidate. Key features to assess: Black's d4 pawn wedge, the e5 knight hitting d3/f3/g4/c4, White's b5 bishop pinning c6, undeveloped c1 bishop, and no castling rights remaining for White.
